description.value: Arbutus Routes is a locally owned full-service bike shop on Whistler's Blackcomb Way, specializing in high-end mountain bike rentals, guided tours, and year-round workshop servicing. Their rental fleet spans downhill, enduro, trail, e-MTB, gravel, and family bikes from premium brands including Yeti, Transition, Specialized, and Cervelo. Guided tour offerings extend across the Sea to Sky corridor, covering Whistler, Squamish, and Pemberton — including multi-day itineraries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a full-service bike shop with rentals, guided tours, workshop servicing ('Workshop Servicing Year-round'), and an extensive parts/components catalog including a dedicated eBike Parts section. OSM tags (repair=yes, parts=yes, pump=yes, rental=yes, tools=yes) are consistent with and largely corroborated by the website. The website confirms the phone number and domain URL matching OSM; a street address is not displayed in the fetched homepage text.
concerns: Website header says 'OPEN for the season!' which suggests possible seasonal operation, though the site also states 'Workshop Servicing Year-round' — the seasonal phrasing may refer only to tours/rentals. Worth confirming operating season scope.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Arbutus Routes is a well-established, locally owned full-service bike shop in Whistler with confirmed rentals, guided tours, parts, and year-round workshop servicing — a strong fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.

Pump available.detail: Not explicitly named on website but consistent with full-service shop offering tools and repair

Touring parts stocked.detail: Comprehensive parts catalog on website: brakes, drivetrain (cassettes, chains, derailleurs, chainrings, cranksets), suspension (forks, shocks), saddles, seatposts, wheels & tires (tires, tubes, rims, hubs, spokes), and tools/lubes

E-bike service.detail: 'eBike Parts' listed as a dedicated category under Components on the website; shop rents and sells multiple e-MTB models (Yeti LTe, Yeti MTe, Specialized Turbo Levo, Transition Regulator)

Guided rides.detail: Multiple guided tour options listed: Whistler/Squamish/Pemberton singletrack, enduro, e-MTB, Bike Park, scenic valley, and multi-day Sea to Sky tours; MTB skills coaching (Bike Park and Trail/Enduro) also offered

wow_evidence: locally owned full-service bike shop... guided tours... multi-day itineraries
